title: Fundraising Channel Yield Comparison
description: Five fundraising channels compared on the two axes that actually decide the choice: dollars raised and volunteer hours spent.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club

educational.audience: Club leaders choosing how to raise money

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given typical yield and effort figures for five fundraising channels, the learner compares them to select an appropriate channel for a specific funding need and time budget.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Hover a bar for exact figures; two y-axes let dollars and hours share one chart
pedagogical.assessment: Give a funding need and an hours budget and ask which channel fits.
